subject.title: fix(channels): prevent outbound echoes and expose native login

question: Should OpenClaw publish the generic outbound-echo identity registry as a stable plugin SDK contract, including the widened drop-capable turn-result semantics, rather than keeping this as a Discord-local repair?
rationale: The branch intentionally adds public SDK exports, documentation, compatibility-barrel surface, and changed inbound result semantics; code review cannot safely choose the permanent plugin contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the shared SDK contract
options.body: Keep the generic registry and result-type widening, provided real Discord and Slack behavior proof is added before merge.

options.title: Narrow to Discord
options.body: Retain a bounded Discord-owned repair and avoid publishing the registry until a cross-plugin SDK need is separately approved.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the generic registry and result-type widening, provided real Discord and Slack behavior proof is added before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current contributor has the strongest demonstrated context for the channel ownership and lifecycle rationale in this PR.
